payload.rebuttal: argued: The named edit removes the `--` separator from the ls-tree command. I tested this directly: for git ls-tree, a plain pathspec like .saffron/specs/ is never ambiguous with a revision or option, so `--` changes nothing here; I ran both spellings against a populated tree and against an empty tree and got identical exit codes and identical (empty) output in both cases. The mutation is behaviorally inert for the fixed constant _SPEC_DIR this code always passes, so no test, mine or anyone else's, could distinguish the two versions by observing output. I left the `--` in place because it is still correct defensive practice and matches the spec's own instruction, but there is no adequacy gap to close: the two programs compute the same thing for every input this code can produce.
